how_to_use: Add real learner words here. Nothing shows on the site while this list is empty.
Each entry needs: quote (their own words, unedited), name, role (title and kind of company, no employer name unless they agreed), permission (how and when they said yes), show_on.
show_on takes any of: home, course, classroom, coaching, workshops.
An entry without a permission note is skipped by the build.

example_entry_not_shown.quote: Paste the learner's own sentence here.
example_entry_not_shown.name: First name and initial, or full name if they agreed
example_entry_not_shown.role: Senior Manager, Engineering · global capability centre
